name: maodouchat-rebuild
description: Stabilize and modernize the Maodouchat client UI and core chat functionality, audit backend usability, test locally, then commit/push and deploy to the specified Hong Kong server after verification.

tasks.subject: Audit client UI
tasks.description: Audit the repository client UI, locate duplicate switches and theme issues, inspect Murexide/Telegram reference folders, and report exact files plus a prioritized implementation plan. Do not make edits yet.
tasks.output:
UI 审计完成（只读，未改任何文件）。仓库：Android Jetpack Compose 客户端，设置层级 SettingsScreen→AccountSecurity/Notifications/General/ThemeEditor/FakeChat。

【A. 重复开关/冲突控件（按优先级）】
1. 强调色双控（P1，最严重）：General 设置 AccentColorRow（SettingsSubScreens.kt:2927-2979，写 ThemePreferences.accent 7色预设）vs 主题编辑器 accent 槽（ThemeEditorScreen.kt:322-334 + CustomThemeStore.kt:27 SLOTS"accent"）。Theme.kt:126-128 先应用强调色预设，:146 applyOverrides 又静默覆盖 primary → 编辑器设过 accent 后，设置页强调色选择"失灵"，优先级隐藏、UI 无任何提示。
2. 发送气泡色双控（P1）：ChatBubbleColorRow（SettingsSubScreens.kt:2811-2816，按账号 bubble_color）vs 编辑器 chat_outBubble 槽。NavGraph.kt:355-378 resolveSentBubble(themeSentSpec, customized, userColor)：设置行 customized 时设置赢、仅编辑器设置时编辑器赢——与强调色优先级相反，规则不一致。
3. 聊天背景双控（P2）：ChatWallpaperRow（SettingsSubScreens.kt:2795-2809，16预设+自定义图）vs 编辑器 chat_background 槽。ChatDetailScreen.kt:483-487 resolveBackground(preset,dark,fallback=palette.chatBackground)：非默认壁纸赢、默认时编辑器赢。
4. 未读优先双表面（P2）：General 开关（SettingsSubScreens.kt:3375-3399 → SettingsSubViewModels.kt:1498-1503）vs ChatListScreen.kt:701-719 提示条点击即 setUnreadPriorityEnabled(false)（ChatListViewModel.kt:680-685）——同 pref 两个写入口，提示条无重开路径。
5. 死代码（P3）：GeneralSettingsScreen showLanguageDialog 弹窗永不可打开（SettingsSubScreens.kt:2697 声明、2887-2920 渲染，全文件无 showLanguageDialog=true 赋值）——9.3xx 语言控件去重后遗留。
6. 孤儿文件（P3）：app/src/main/java/com/maodouchat/ui/theme/LiquidPress.kt（163行，git status ?? 未跟踪、无引用、git log 无提交）——9.294 Liquid Glass revert 后遗留，仍会被编入 APK。
7. 冗余双写（P3）：ClientPrefsSync.kt:48-53 setMode 已写 pref 又直接 putString("theme_mode")。

【B. 主题/深色模式】总体健康：isSystemInDarkTheme 仅 Theme.kt:93 默认参数，屏幕层全走 LocalDarkTheme/colorScheme；深色 token 已补全（Theme.kt:52-68）；values-night/themes.xml+splash_dark 已修闪白；widget 日夜色齐。残余：Theme.kt:48/70 私有别名 LightColorScheme/DarkColorScheme 与 Maodou*Scheme 重复（死别名）；Theme.kt:151 themeKey 未含 oledBlack（OLED 切换无帷幕过渡，小视觉）；FakeChatScreen/LoginScreen 硬编码白多为有意设计，无实锤 bug。

【C. reference 文件夹】reference/ 经 .git/info/exclude 忽略（本地参考不提交）：Telegram 官方 Android 全源码（TMessagesProj，.attheme 资产 day/night/arctic/bluebubbles/darkblue）；Murexide（云湖 M3 客户端，ui/theme/liquidglass、SettingsStorage 单一 datastore、ThemeModeTest/ThemeBoundaryTest）。本 app 已对齐 TG .attheme 导入导出（CustomThemeStore.TG_KEY_MAP 子集）与 Murexide 对比度机制（MIN_TEXT_CONTRAST=4.5）。架构差距：本 app 7+ 个零散 Preferences 对象（全局/按账号/云同步三套并存）是重复开关根因；Murexide 单一 SettingsStorage 可作收敛参照；TG 主题编辑器有逐元素预览说明而本 app ThemeEditor 的 slot 未映射展示 TG 键名。

【D. 优先实施计划】
P1（正确性）：①统一强调色双控——编辑器 accent 槽写入时联动清 ThemePreferences.accent 或在 AccentColorRow 显示"被自定义主题覆盖"态+一键清除（文件：Theme.kt:123-146、SettingsSubScreens.kt:2927、ThemeEditorScreen.kt、CustomThemeStore.kt）；②统一气泡色/背景优先级规则（建议编辑器覆盖层最后生效=编辑器赢，与 accent 一致），NavGraph.kt:355-378 与 ChatDetailScreen.kt:483-487 同步；③未读优先提示条改为不写 pref（仅"知道了"），或加回设置入口。
P2（清理）：④删 showLanguageDialog 死弹窗；⑤删除或正式接入 LiquidPress.kt；⑥删 Theme.kt 重复别名；⑦ClientPrefsSync 去冗余双写；⑧themeKey 补 oledBlack。
P3（架构防再犯）：⑨参照 Murexide SettingsStorage 收敛偏好存储为单一对象，杜绝"两个控件写同一视觉属性"。

tasks.subject: Inspect deployment path
tasks.description: Inspect git remotes, deployment scripts, service layout assumptions, and server access feasibility. Do not modify or deploy anything. Report safe deployment prerequisites and exact commands, without exposing credentials.
tasks.output:
Deployment path inspected (read-only). Findings:
1) GIT: repo /Users/xalor/Documents/Maodouchat, origin=https://github.com/xalor888/Maodouchat.git (HTTPS), branch main, 4 commits ahead of origin/main (f01bac1, 8b99dea, f4af222, 64b5874). Push path works: gh CLI authed as xalor888 (repo scope), `git push --dry-run origin main` succeeded (b486b69..f01bac1).
2) GIT HYGIENE RISK: `.agent-teams/` is untracked and NOT in .gitignore — a plain `git add -A` would commit team state (inbox messages) to the public repo. Must add `.agent-teams/` to .gitignore before any commit. `app/src/main/java/com/maodouchat/ui/theme/LiquidPress.kt` is untracked source that should be committed (it is not ignored).
3) DEPLOY MODEL: Docker Compose stack (docker-compose.yml): caddy:2.10.2-alpine TLS proxy (host ports 80/443) → Ktor server (builds from server/Dockerfile, eclipse-temurin:21, internal 8080 only, read-only rootfs, cap_drop ALL, /health/live + /health/ready) + postgres:16-alpine + optional coturn (3478, 49160-49200/udp). Named volumes: postgres_data, server_uploads, caddy_data, caddy_config. Production mode enforces: HTTPS BASE_URL == PUBLIC_HOST, JWT_SECRET>=32, Postgres, SEED_DEMO_USERS=false; RELAXED_VERIFICATION=true waives SMTP/TURN/PUSH.
4) SCRIPTS (run ON the server at repo root): `scripts/deploy.sh` (idempotent one-click; --doctor read-only preflight, --dry-run, --relaxed, --bootstrap-admin, --no-build; requires Docker 24+ and Compose v2; auto-generates .env secrets); `scripts/update.sh` (backup → git pull fast-forward → rebuild → redeploy; requires existing .env + git checkout); plus status.sh / backup-production.sh / restore-production.sh. CI validates compose config; release.yml ships selfhost kit on v* tags.
5) SERVER ACCESS — BLOCKER: ~/.ssh/config_maodou defines alias `maodou` → root@64.90.12.166:22 (ControlMaster). Port 22 TCP is OPEN. But key auth failed ("Permission denied (password)"): no private key on disk (~/.ssh has no id_*), ssh-agent has no identities. Automated SSH/deploy from this environment is NOT possible until the user supplies a key (place it in ~/.ssh, add IdentityFile to config_maodou, or ssh-add) or a password. No docker on this Mac either — deployment happens on the server, not locally.
6) SAFE COMMANDS (after creds provided): local `git add` (excluding .agent-teams) → `git commit` → `git push origin main`; server preflight `bash scripts/deploy.sh --doctor`; first-time `bash scripts/deploy.sh --host <PUBLIC_HOST> --email <EMAIL> --relaxed` (existing stack: `bash scripts/update.sh`). Open firewall ports 80/443 (and 3478+49160-49200/udp if TURN wanted).
